+"""Test cache invalidation behavior."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+async def test_cache_invalidation_after_event_creation(client, auth_headers, tokens):
+    """Test that cache is properly invalidated after creating an event."""
+    
+    # Create first event
+    event1 = {
+        "title": "First Event",
+        "starts_at": "2026-09-01T18:00:00+00:00",
+        "capacity": 50,
+        "price": "30.00",
+        "currency": "USD",
+    }
+    
+    create_response1 = await client.post("/events", headers=auth_headers(tokens["alice"]), json=event1)
+    assert create_response1.status_code == 201
+    event1_id = create_response1.json()["id"]
+    
+    # Get event list (will be cached)
+    list_response1 = await client.get("/events")
+    assert list_response1.status_code == 200
+    event_list1 = list_response1.json()
+    assert event1_id in [event["id"] for event in event_list1["items"]]
+    initial_total = event_list1["total"]
+    
+    # Create second event
+    event2 = {
+        "title": "Second Event",
+        "starts_at": "2026-09-02T18:00:00+00:00",
+        "capacity": 60,
+        "price": "35.00",
+        "currency": "USD",
+    }
+    
+    create_response2 = await client.post("/events", headers=auth_headers(tokens["alice"]), json=event2)
+    assert create_response2.status_code == 201
+    event2_id = create_response2.json()["id"]
+    
+    # Get event list again - should NOT use stale cache
+    list_response2 = await client.get("/events")
+    assert list_response2.status_code == 200
+    event_list2 = list_response2.json()
+    
+    # Both events should be in the list
+    event_ids_in_list = [event["id"] for event in event_list2["items"]]
+    assert event1_id in event_ids_in_list, f"Event1 {event1_id} not found in list"
+    assert event2_id in event_ids_in_list, f"Event2 {event2_id} not found in list"
+    
+    # Total should have increased
+    assert event_list2["total"] == initial_total + 1, f"Expected total {initial_total + 1}, got {event_list2['total']}"
+
+
+async def test_cache_invalidation_with_different_pagination(client, auth_headers, tokens):
+    """Test that cache is invalidated for all pagination parameters."""
+    
+    # Get first page (limit=5, offset=0)
+    list_response1 = await client.get("/events?limit=5&offset=0")
+    assert list_response1.status_code == 200
+    initial_count_page1 = len(list_response1.json()["items"])
+    
+    # Get second page (limit=5, offset=5)
+    list_response2 = await client.get("/events?limit=5&offset=5")
+    assert list_response2.status_code == 200
+    initial_count_page2 = len(list_response2.json()["items"])
+    
+    # Create a new event
+    new_event = {
+        "title": "Pagination Test Event",
+        "starts_at": "2026-09-01T18:00:00+00:00",
+        "capacity": 50,
+        "price": "30.00",
+        "currency": "USD",
+    }
+    
+    create_response = await client.post("/events", headers=auth_headers(tokens["alice"]), json=new_event)
+    assert create_response.status_code == 201
+    new_event_id = create_response.json()["id"]
+    
+    # Get first page again - should include new event (cache invalidated)
+    list_response3 = await client.get("/events?limit=5&offset=0")
+    assert list_response3.status_code == 200
+    new_count_page1 = len(list_response3.json()["items"])
+    event_ids_page1 = [event["id"] for event in list_response3.json()["items"]]
+    
+    # Get second page again - should not use stale cache
+    list_response4 = await client.get("/events?limit=5&offset=5")
+    assert list_response4.status_code == 200
+    new_count_page2 = len(list_response4.json()["items"])
+    event_ids_page2 = [event["id"] for event in list_response4.json()["items"]]
+    
+    # The new event should be in one of the pages (depending on sorting)
+    assert new_event_id in event_ids_page1 or new_event_id in event_ids_page2, \
+        f"New event {new_event_id} not found in any page"
+    
+    # At least one page should have changed
+    assert new_count_page1 != initial_count_page1 or new_count_page2 != initial_count_page2, \
+        "Cache was not properly invalidated for pagination"

+"""Comprehensive cache behavior tests."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+async def test_multiple_events_creation_and_listing(client, auth_headers, tokens):
+    """Test creating multiple events and verifying they all appear in the list."""
+    
+    # Get initial event count
+    initial_response = await client.get("/events")
+    initial_count = initial_response.json()["total"]
+    
+    # Create multiple events
+    events_to_create = [
+        {
+            "title": f"Event {i}",
+            "starts_at": f"2026-09-{i:02d}T18:00:00+00:00",
+            "capacity": 50 + i,
+            "price": f"{30.00 + i:.2f}",
+            "currency": "USD",
+        }
+        for i in range(1, 6)
+    ]
+    
+    created_event_ids = []
+    
+    for event_data in events_to_create:
+        create_response = await client.post("/events", headers=auth_headers(tokens["alice"]), json=event_data)
+        assert create_response.status_code == 201
+        created_event_ids.append(create_response.json()["id"])
+    
+    # Get the event list - should include all newly created events
+    final_response = await client.get("/events")
+    assert final_response.status_code == 200
+    final_list = final_response.json()
+    
+    # Verify all created events are in the list
+    event_ids_in_list = [event["id"] for event in final_list["items"]]
+    for event_id in created_event_ids:
+        assert event_id in event_ids_in_list, f"Event {event_id} not found in final list"
+    
+    # Verify the total count increased correctly
+    assert final_list["total"] == initial_count + len(events_to_create)
+
+
+async def test_cache_consistency_across_requests(client, auth_headers, tokens):
+    """Test that cache remains consistent across multiple requests."""
+    
+    # Create an event
+    new_event = {
+        "title": "Consistency Test Event",
+        "starts_at": "2026-09-01T18:00:00+00:00",
+        "capacity": 50,
+        "price": "30.00",
+        "currency": "USD",
+    }
+    
+    create_response = await client.post("/events", headers=auth_headers(tokens["alice"]), json=new_event)
+    assert create_response.status_code == 201
+    event_id = create_response.json()["id"]
+    
+    # Make multiple requests to the event list
+    for _ in range(5):
+        list_response = await client.get("/events")
+        assert list_response.status_code == 200
+        event_list = list_response.json()
+        
+        # Verify the new event is always present
+        event_ids_in_list = [event["id"] for event in event_list["items"]]
+        assert event_id in event_ids_in_list, f"Event {event_id} not found in list"
+
+
+async def test_event_list_with_pagination_after_creation(client, auth_headers, tokens):
+    """Test that pagination works correctly after event creation."""
+    
+    # Create an event
+    new_event = {
+        "title": "Pagination Consistency Event",
+        "starts_at": "2026-09-01T18:00:00+00:00",
+        "capacity": 50,
+        "price": "30.00",
+        "currency": "USD",
+    }
+    
+    create_response = await client.post("/events", headers=auth_headers(tokens["alice"]), json=new_event)
+    assert create_response.status_code == 201
+    event_id = create_response.json()["id"]
+    
+    # Test different pagination parameters
+    pagination_params = [
+        {"limit": 5, "offset": 0},
+        {"limit": 10, "offset": 0},
+        {"limit": 5, "offset": 5},
+        {"limit": 100, "offset": 0},
+    ]
+    
+    found_in_any_page = False
+    
+    for params in pagination_params:
+        query_string = f"?limit={params['limit']}&offset={params['offset']}"
+        list_response = await client.get(f"/events{query_string}")
+        assert list_response.status_code == 200
+        event_list = list_response.json()
+        
+        event_ids_in_list = [event["id"] for event in event_list["items"]]
+        if event_id in event_ids_in_list:
+            found_in_any_page = True
+            break
+    
+    assert found_in_any_page, f"Event {event_id} not found in any pagination result"

+"""Test that caching doesn't prevent newly created events from appearing in the list."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+async def test_newly_created_event_appears_in_list_with_caching(client, auth_headers, tokens):
+    """Test that a newly created event is visible in the event list even with caching."""
+    new_event = {
+        "title": "Cached Test Event",
+        "starts_at": "2026-09-01T18:00:00+00:00",
+        "capacity": 50,
+        "price": "30.00",
+        "currency": "USD",
+    }
+    
+    # First, get the event list to populate the cache
+    initial_list_response = await client.get("/events")
+    assert initial_list_response.status_code == 200
+    initial_event_list = initial_list_response.json()
+    initial_count = initial_event_list["total"]
+    
+    # Create a new event
+    create_response = await client.post("/events", headers=auth_headers(tokens["alice"]), json=new_event)
+    assert create_response.status_code == 201
+    created_event = create_response.json()
+    event_id = created_event["id"]
+    
+    # Immediately fetch the event list again (should use cache)
+    cached_list_response = await client.get("/events")
+    assert cached_list_response.status_code == 200
+    cached_event_list = cached_list_response.json()
+    
+    # Check that the newly created event is in the cached list
+    event_ids_in_list = [event["id"] for event in cached_event_list["items"]]
+    assert event_id in event_ids_in_list, f"Event {event_id} not found in cached event list: {event_ids_in_list}"
+    
+    # Also verify the total count increased
+    assert cached_event_list["total"] == initial_count + 1, f"Expected total {initial_count + 1}, got {cached_event_list['total']}"
